{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows increasing negativity (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 transitions), indicating downward pressure.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% to align with historical volatility.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes 0.00 followed by 0.00 or negative sentiment, suggesting delayed correction.",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if model forecast is > 10% above 15-day high, reduce by 10-20% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50 (positive), slightly increase forecast to reflect potential momentum, but cap at 5% above recent peak.",
    "If forecast is consistently below true outcome over 3 consecutive days, adjust upward by 5-10% to avoid underestimating rebound potential."
  ]
}
